newsitem.title: UK: UK's Lady in Leisure plans April 24 AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: UK's Lady in Leisure plans April 24 AIM debut.

text.p: Lady in Leisure Group Plc, operator of a chain of women-only health and fitness clubs, said on Thursday it plans to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on April 24 via a placing.
Graham Forrest, joint managing director, said the company provided services that were poorly served by existing mixed clubs.
"Women can feel intimidated by men and fitness fanatics at mixed clubs," Forrest said. "At Lady in Leisure they can state their goals and we will help them achieve them."
"Mixed clubs tend to be more lifestyle orientated but we focus on members' individual goals."
The company said the placing price of the shares would be 110p and would raise 1.7 million stg, valuing the group at 4.6 million stg.
Lady in Leisure owns and manages eight ladies-only health and fitness clubs in the UK but said it aims to establish a further eight clubs within the next 16 months.
The company forecast a pre-tax profit of not less than 34,000 stg in the year ending July 31, compared with a pre-tax loss of 164,000 stg for the previous year.
